items.name: Cracked Teacup
items.description: Still holds tea, mostly. The crack whispers a little when the kettle boils.

items.name: Candle Stub
items.description: A candle that has burned for three hundred years and refuses to get any shorter.

items.name: Tarnished Key
items.description: Opens a door somewhere in the tower. The door moves house when nobody is looking.

items.name: Backwards Compass
items.description: Its needle points to whatever you have just lost. Rarely helpful, always smug.

items.name: Chipped Inkwell
items.description: The ink inside never runs dry, but it only ever writes apologies and shopping lists.

items.name: Mismatched Specs
items.description: One lens shows what is there. The other shows what was there a moment ago.

items.name: Bottled Storm
items.description: A small, furious thunderstorm. Please do not tap the glass; it takes it personally.

items.name: Moon in a Jar
items.description: Caught on a clear night and kept ever since. It waxes and wanes whenever the jar is not watched.

items.name: Eclipse Amulet
items.description: A black sun ringed in ember gold. The dark centre drinks light, and the corona never quite stops burning.
